heroText: I make your problem my own. Then we walk it together, from the first messy question to a product people actually use.
servicesTitle: What I can do for you

process.title: Listen first
process.text: We start with your users, your data and your constraints. Not with a moodboard.

process.title: Own it together
process.text: I work as part of your team. Shared goals, honest trade-offs, no gaps between design and build.

process.title: Ship, then improve
process.text: Designs that get built, launched and measured. Then we make them better.

ctaText: 30 minutes, free. Bring a messy problem and leave with a clear first step.
